description: This file defines the `CompressedUpdate` class, which manages updates to compressed Distributed Data (DData) in a pub/sub context, including creation of empty updates, replace-all updates, and snapshot functionality.

classes.name: CompressedUpdate
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractIndelUpdate that encapsulates updates (inserts and deletes) of compressed distributed data, providing factory methods for creating empty, replace-all, and snapshot updates.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty CompressedUpdate instance with no inserts or deletes.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Creates a CompressedUpdate that replaces all existing data with the specified set of inserts.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current state of the update, including copies of inserts and deletes, and the replace-all flag.
